Fellowship overview

This Radboud PhD develops physics-informed generative models for synthetic energy data. The researcher will work on models that respect physical networks and operational constraints, helping produce privacy-preserving data for grid planning and energy-sector decisions.

Research Areas

  • Generative AI
  • Energy systems
  • Privacy-preserving data

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionSalaried PhD position
Stipend / salaryEUR 3,204–4,051 gross/month
Duration1.5-year initial contract; 2.5-year extension after positive evaluation

The salary starts at EUR 3,204 gross per month and increases to EUR 4,051 in year four. Holiday allowance and year-end bonus are additional.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationMSc, completed or expected before the start, in computing, AI, data science, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering or a related field.
LanguageGood spoken and written English required
Further conditionsRelevant MSc; English; four-year appointment subject to first-stage evaluation.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round25 October 2026
LocationNetherlands
Details checked9 October 2026
